[LNAM.7.3] **Determinism.** NFC is a fixed function given the pinned Unicode version
([LNAM.2.2.5]). The compiler applies it and emits NFC names; the runtime compares them
byte-for-byte, so identifier identity is deterministic across engines with no runtime
Unicode dependency. `null` from a fallible conversion is the single canonical `null`
([LNUL.6]), so it hashes, orders, and encodes identically. The one new determinism
obligation is the pinned Unicode version, which the compiler's version implies
([LNAM.2.2.5]): artefacts compiled against different pins belong to different
version series, which a runtime keeps apart ([LDET.1.10]).
